7210-the-motor-girls-on-waters-blue-or-t.title: The Motor Girls On Waters Blue Or The Strange Cruise Of The
7210-the-motor-girls-on-waters-blue-or-t.creator: Margaret Penrose
7210-the-motor-girls-on-waters-blue-or-t.description: A book by Margaret Penrose. "Well, I can't stand here admiring nature!" exclaimed Cora Kimball, with a sudden descent to the commonplace. "Mother will be wanting that worsted, and if we are to play bridge tonight, I must help Nancy get the rooms in some kind of shape."

arxiv-2201-12030.title: Polynomial affine model of gravity in three-dimensions
arxiv-2201-12030.creator: Oscar Castillo-Felisola, Bastian Grez, Oscar Orellana, Jose Perdiguero, Francisca Ramirez, Aureliano Skirzewski, Alfonso R. Zerwekh
arxiv-2201-12030.description: Abstract In this work, we explore a three-dimensional formulation of the polynomial affine model of gravity, which is a model that extends general relativity by relaxing the equivalence principle through the exclusion of the metric from the set of fundamental fields.

arxiv-2203-10005.title: Application of Top-hat Transformation for Enhanced Blood Vessel Extraction
arxiv-2203-10005.creator: Tithi Parna Das 1, Sheetal Praharaj 1, Sarita Swain 1, Sumanshu Agarwal 1, Kundan Kumar 2
arxiv-2203-10005.description: Abstract In the medical domain, different computer-aided diagnosis systems have been proposed to extract blood vessels from retinal fundus images for the clinical treatment of vascular diseases. Accurate extraction of blood vessels from the fundus images using a computer-generated method can help the clinician to produce timely and accurate reports for the patient suffering from these diseases.

arxiv-2301-05585.title: Bivariate distributions on the unit square: Theoretical properties and applications
arxiv-2301-05585.creator: Roberto Vila, Narayanaswamy Balakrishnan, Helton Saulo, Peter Zörnig
arxiv-2301-05585.description: Abstract We introduce the bivariate unit-log-symmetric model based on the bivariate log-symmetric distribution (BLS) defined in Vila et al., 2022 as a flexible family of bivariate distributions over the unit square. We then study its mathematical properties such as stochastic representations, quantiles, conditional distributions, independence of the marginal distributions and moments.

arxiv-2303-07211.title: Bounds and Algorithms for Frameproof Codes and Related Combinatorial Structures
arxiv-2303-07211.creator: Marco Dalai 1 , Stefano Della Fiore 1 2 , Adele A. Rescigno 2 and Ugo Vaccaro 2
arxiv-2303-07211.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Marco Dalai 1 , Stefano Della Fiore 1 2 , Adele A. Rescigno 2 and Ugo Vaccaro 2. In this paper, we study upper bounds on the minimum length of frameproof codes introduced by Boneh and Shaw [ 3 ] to protect copyrighted materials.

arxiv-2304-06084.title: Cosmology with one galaxy? - The ASTRID model and robustness
arxiv-2304-06084.creator: Nicolas Echeverri, Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro, Chaitanya Chawak, Yueying Ni, ChangHoon Hahn, Elena Hernández-Martínez, Romain Teyssier, Daniel Anglés-Alcázar, Klaus Dolag, Tiago Castro
arxiv-2304-06084.description: Abstract Recent work has pointed out the potential existence of a tight relation between the cosmological parameter Ω m \Omega_{\rm m} , at fixed Ω b \Omega_{\rm b} , and the properties of individual galaxies in state-of-the-art cosmological hydrodynamic simulations.

arxiv-2308-11189.title: Diversity Measures: Domain-Independent Proxies for Failure in Language Model Queries
arxiv-2308-11189.creator: Noel Ngu, Nathaniel Lee, Paulo Shakarian
arxiv-2308-11189.description: Abstract Error prediction in large language models often relies on domain-specific information. In this paper, we present measures for quantification of error in the response of a large language model based on the diversity of responses to a given prompt - hence independent of the underlying application.

arxiv-2403-03847.title: Flexible Optimization for Cyber-Physical and Human Systems Thanks: *This work was partly supported by the Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR) with the project ANR-23-CE48-0011-01.
arxiv-2403-03847.creator: Andrea Simonetto *
arxiv-2403-03847.description: Abstract Can we allow humans to pick among different, yet reasonably similar, decisions? Are we able to construct optimization problems whose outcome are sets of feasible, close-to-optimal decisions for human users to pick from, instead of a single, hardly explainable, do-as-I-say “optimal” directive? In this paper, we explore two complementary ways to render optimization problems stemming from cyber-physical applications flexible.

arxiv-2404-15106.title: Overlapping plastic events as a mechanism for irreversible dynamics in amorphous solids under oscillatory shear
arxiv-2404-15106.creator: Asaf Szulc, Ido Regev
arxiv-2404-15106.description: Abstract The origin of the transition from asymptotically reversible to asymptotically irreversible response in amorphous solids subject to oscillatory shear is still unknown. It is known that the plastic events that result from shearing always involve localized particle rearrangements, but it is unclear why some are reversible while others are not.

arxiv-2502-11596.title: LLM Embeddings for Deep Learning on Tabular Data
arxiv-2502-11596.creator: Boshko Koloski Andrei Margeloiu Xiangjian Jiang, Blaž Škrlj Nikola Simidjievski Mateja Jamnik
arxiv-2502-11596.description: Abstract Tabular deep-learning methods require embedding numerical and categorical input features into high-dimensional spaces before processing them. Existing methods deal with this heterogeneous nature of tabular data by employing separate type-specific encoding approaches. This limits the cross-table transfer potential and the exploitation of pre-trained knowledge.

arxiv-2507-18312.title: Primordial black hole formation in matter domination
arxiv-2507-18312.creator: E. Ebrahimian, A. Abolhasani, M. Mirbabayi
arxiv-2507-18312.description: Abstract We study Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) formed by the collapse of rare primordial fluctuations during an early period of Matter Domination. The collapse threshold strongly depends on the shape of the peaks, decreasing as they become flatter and hence rarer.

arxiv-2508-10809.title: Entangled Polariton States in the Visible and Mid-Infrared Spectral Ranges
arxiv-2508-10809.creator: Vladislav Yu. Shishkov 1, Oleg Kotov 2, Darius Urbonas 3, Lee A. Rozema 4, Francisco J. Garcia-Vidal 2,5, Johannes Feist 2,5, Anton V. Zasedatelev 1
arxiv-2508-10809.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vladislav Yu. Shishkov 1, Oleg Kotov 2, Darius Urbonas 3, Lee A. Rozema 4, Francisco J. Garcia-Vidal 2,5, Johannes Feist 2,5, Anton V. Zasedatelev 1. Entanglement generation in polariton systems is fundamentally constrained by high losses and decoherence, which typically outweigh polariton nonlinearities. Here, we propose a conceptually different approach that uses optomechanical interactions, rather than polariton–polariton interactions, to generate entangled polaritons.

arxiv-2511-10689.title: Equilibrium Dynamics and Mitigation of Gender Bias in Synthetically Generated Data
arxiv-2511-10689.creator: Ashish Kattamuri, Arpita Vats, Harshwardhan Fartale, Rahul Raja, Akshata Kishore Moharir, Ishita Prasad
arxiv-2511-10689.description: Abstract Recursive prompting with large language models enables scalable synthetic dataset generation but introduces the risk of bias amplification. We investigate gender bias dynamics across three generations of recursive text generation using three complementary evaluation frameworks: rule-based pattern matching, embedding based semantic similarity, and downstream task performance. Experiments with three initial bias levels (0.1, 0.3, 0.

arxiv-2601-23041.title: One-shot Optimized Steering Vector for Hallucination Mitigation for VLMs
arxiv-2601-23041.creator: Youxu Shi, Suorong Yang*, Dong Liu*
arxiv-2601-23041.description: Abstract Vision Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on multimodal tasks but still suffer from hallucination and safety-related failures that persist even at scale. Steering offers a lightweight technique to improve model performance. However, steering, whether input-dependent or input-independent, achieves a meaningful trade-off between efficiency and effectiveness.

arxiv-2604-24272.title: SVOM /C-GFT: Instrumentation and Performances on the SVOM Alerts
arxiv-2604-24272.creator: Chao Wu, Zhe Kang, Xiao-Meng Lu, Xu-Hui Han, Li-Ping Xin, Pin-Pin Zhang, You Lv, Cheng-Wei Zhu, Ruo-Son Zhang, Jin-Song Deng, Yu-Lei Qiu, Mao-Hai Huang, Hong-Bo Cai, Hai-Bo Hu, Lei Huang, Lei Jia, Yu Luo, Jing Wang, Mo Zhang, Si-Cheng Zou, Zhen-Wei Li, Cheng-Zhi Liu, Jian-Yan Wei

arxiv-2606-30622.creator: Victor Fournet, Martin Campos Pinto, Emmanuel Franck, Victor Michel-Dansac, [1ex] Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, Garching, Germany

europmc-pmc5753373.creator: Lefkowitz EJ, Dempsey DM, Hendrickson RC, Orton RJ, Siddell SG, Smith DB.
europmc-pmc5753373.description: The International Committee on Taxonomy of Viruses (ICTV) is charged with the task of developing, refining, and maintaining a universal virus taxonomy. This task encompasses the classification of virus species and higher-level taxa according to the genetic and biological...

plos-pone-0338168.title: Comprehensive metabolomic characterization of defense reprogramming in Castanea mollissima under Oligonychus ununguis feeding stress
plos-pone-0338168.creator: Xinfang Zhang, Shuhang Zhang, Ying Li, Yan Guo, Jinyu Liu, Jiayi Liu, Liying Fan, Guangpeng Wang
plos-pone-0338168.description: Comprehensive metabolomic characterization of defense reprogramming in Castanea mollissima under Oligonychus ununguis feeding stress

pmc-10545711.title: Electronic strengthening mechanism of covalent Si via excess electron/hole doping
pmc-10545711.creator: Hiroki Noda, Shumpei Sakaguchi, Ryoga Fujita, Susumu Minami, Hiroyuki Hirakata, Takahiro Shimada
pmc-10545711.description: Brittle fracture of a covalent material is ultimately governed by the strength of the electronic bonds. Recently, attempts have been made to alter the mechanical properties including fracture strength by excess electron/hole doping. However, the underlying mechanics/mechanism of how these doped electrons/holes interact with the bond and changes its strength is yet to be revealed.

pmc-10616130.title: Visualizing Data Interoperability for Food Systems Sustainability Research—From Spider Webs to Neural Networks
pmc-10616130.creator: Emily M Jennings-Dobbs, Shavawn M Forester, Adam Drewnowski
pmc-10616130.description: Food systems represent all elements and activities needed to feed the growing global population. Research on sustainable food systems is transdisciplinary, relying on the interconnected domains of health, nutrition, economics, society, and environment. The current lack of interoperability across databases poses a challenge to advancing research on food systems transformation.

pmc-11352662.title: Fire up Biosensor Technology to Assess the Vitality of Trees after Wildfires
pmc-11352662.creator: Eleftherios Touloupakis, Isabela Calegari Moia, Raffaella Margherita Zampieri, Claudia Cocozza, Niccolò Frassinelli, Enrico Marchi, Cristiano Foderi, Tiziana Di Lorenzo, Negar Rezaie, Valerio Giorgio Muzzini, Maria Laura Traversi, Alessio Giovannelli
pmc-11352662.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The development of tools to quickly identify the fate of damaged trees after a stress event such as a wildfire is of great importance. In this context, an innovative approach to assess irreversible physiological damage in trees could help to support the planning of management decisions for disturbed sites to restore biodiversity, protect the environment and understand the adaptations of ecosystem functionality.

pmc-11420275.title: SIMUnet: an open-source tool for simultaneous global fits of EFT Wilson coefficients and PDFs
pmc-11420275.creator: PBSP Collaboration, Mark N. Costantini, Elie Hammou, Zahari Kassabov, Maeve Madigan, Luca Mantani, Manuel Morales-Alvarado, James M. Moore, Maria Ubiali
pmc-11420275.description: We present the open-source SIMUnet code, designed to fit Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) Wilson coefficient alongside Parton Distribution Functions (PDFs) of the proton. SIMUnet can perform SMEFT global fits, as well as simultaneous fits of the PDFs and of an arbitrarily large number of SMEFT degrees of freedom, by including both PDF-dependent and PDF-independent observables.

pmc-11453141.title: RNA Sequencing Analysis of Patients with Chronic Hepatitis B Treated Using PEGylated Interferon
pmc-11453141.creator: Shao-Long Chen, Yao-Jie Shen, Guo-Zhi Chen
pmc-11453141.description: PurposeWorldwide, chronic hepatitis B virus (CHB) infection is a public health concern, ultimately leading to liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Currently, patients with CHB can be treated using polyethylene glycol (PEG)ylated interferon (PEG-IFN) antiviral therapy, which has both immune modulatory and antiviral properties.

pmc-11587154.title: Effects of Extrinsic and Intrinsic Motivation on Selective Activation of Shoulder Girdle Muscles During the Barbell Bench Press Exercise
pmc-11587154.creator: Katarzyna Strońska-Garbień, Artur Terbalyan, Mariola Gepfert, Robert Roczniok, Miłosz Drozd, Artur Gołaś, Adam Zając
pmc-11587154.description: Background/Objectives: This study aimed to investigate the effects of intrinsic and extrinsic motivation on selective muscle activation of the shoulder girdle during the barbell bench press. Specifically, this research focused on how attentional focus on individual muscles, such as the anterior deltoid (AD), pectoralis major (PM), and triceps brachii long (TBL), could influence their electromyographic (EMG) activity during the exercise.

pmc-11727550.title: In-Depth Phenotyping of PIGW-Related Disease and Its Role in 17q12 Genomic Disorder
pmc-11727550.creator: Agnese Feresin, Mathilde Lefebvre, Emilie Sjøstrøm, Caterina Zanus, Elisa Paccagnella, Irene Bruno, Erica Valencic, Anna Morgan, Alberto Tommasini, Christel Thauvin, Allan Bayat, Giorgia Girotto, Luciana Musante
pmc-11727550.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI) biosynthesis defect 11 (GPIBD11), part of the heterogeneous group of congenital disorders of glycosylation, is caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in PIGW. This rare disorder has previously been described in only 12 patients.

pmc-12415896.title: Synthesis of chiral cyclohexane-linked bisimidazolines
pmc-12415896.creator: Changmeng Xi, Qingshan Sun, Jiaxi Xu, Stefan Bräse
pmc-12415896.description: Both chiral bisoxazolines and bisimidazolines are efficient chiral ligands in metal-catalyzed asymmetric organic transformations. Chiral cyclohexane-linked bisimidazolines were prepared from optically active cyclohexane-1,2-dicarboxylic acid and 1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diamines via the monosulfonylation of 1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diamines, condensation of N-sulfonylated 1,2-diphenylethane-1,2-diamines and cyclohexane-1,2-dicarboxylic acid, and the final cyclization with the in situ generated Hendrickson reagent.

pmc-12475995.title: Improvement on Attention Networks Among Military Personnel: The Right IFG and tDCS Matter
pmc-12475995.creator: Hongliang Lu, Ye Miao, Yajuan Zhang, Zhihua Guo, Xianyang Wang, Qianbo Na, Xuanyi Tan, Yan Zhang, Xiaofei Yan, Yang Cao, Wendong Hu, Peng Huang, Jin Ma
pmc-12475995.description: Attention is crucial for military personnel to recover from mental dysfunction and maintain superior cognitive abilities. Transcranial electrical stimulation (tES) is a promising training method for enhancing attention; however, the optimal parameters for tES interventions remain unclear. This study aims to identify the most responsive cortical area and the most effective tES type for attention enhancement.

pmc-12579084.title: Implementation of AI in radiology: the perspective of referring physicians
pmc-12579084.creator: Jennifer Gotta, Leon D. Grünewald, Vitali Koch, Scherwin Mahmoudi, Simon Bernatz, Elena Höhne, Teodora Biciusca, Aynur Gökduman, Christian Wolfram, Christian Booz, Jan-Erik Scholtz, Simon Martin, Katrin Eichler, Tatjana Gruber-Rouh, Andreas Bucher, Ibrahim Yel, Thomas J. Vogl, Philipp Reschke
pmc-12579084.description: ObjectivesAI offers considerable potential to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in radiology. However, its successful implementation depends largely on the trust and acceptance of referring physicians. This study examines physicians’ attitudes toward AI in radiology, identifying key facilitators and barriers to its clinical integration.

pmc-12698893.title: Treatment Persistence After Major Cardiovascular Events in Psoriasis: A Retrospective Cohort Study Comparing Biologic, Systemic, and Phototherapy
pmc-12698893.creator: Hyun Keun Ahn, Sohee Oh, Hyun‐Sun Yoon
pmc-12698893.description: Patients with psoriasis experience significantly higher cardiovascular morbidity compared to the general population. Although certain psoriasis treatments may confer cardioprotective effects, current clinical guidelines addressing treatment continuation following major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) are lacking. Therefore, we conducted a retrospective cohort study using Korean health insurance data (January 2008–October 2021) to examine treatment modifications after MACE in patients with psoriasis.

pmc-12736432.title: Quantitative Assessment of Biomechanical Deviations in Hybrid III Dummy Response Caused by Accessory Lumbar Supports
pmc-12736432.creator: Wanda Górniak, Felipe Jiménez
pmc-12736432.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rear-end collisions remain a significant category of road accidents, despite widespread passive safety systems. Although modern seats are designed to reduce injury risk, the influence of accessory lumbar supports on passenger safety is still insufficiently investigated. This study analyzes the biomechanical response of a Hybrid III 50th percentile dummy on a vehicle seat fitted with various lumbar support types, compared to a reference configuration.

pmc-12927999.title: The Mediating Effect of Socioeconomic Status and Persistent Poverty on Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Pediatric Cancer Mortality in the United States
pmc-12927999.creator: Josiane Kabayundo, Apu Das, Cheng Zheng, Emma Hymel, Krishtee Napit, Shinobu Watanabe‐Galloway
pmc-12927999.description: BackgroundSocioeconomic (SE) factors have been shown to mediate racial and ethnic disparities in adult cancer mortality. However, evidence in pediatric cancer is limited, especially at finer geographic levels.ObjectiveEvaluate the mediating effect of socioeconomic status (SES) and persistent poverty in racial and ethnic disparities in childhood cancer mortality using census tract‐level data.

pmc-13104588.title: Behavioral Phenotyping of Arts Engagement Using 20 Years of the American Time Use Survey
pmc-13104588.creator: Jessica K. Bone, Feifei Bu, Jill K. Sonke, Daisy Fancourt
pmc-13104588.description: Arts and cultural engagement have been linked to health and wellbeing but there has not been any national monitoring of arts and cultural behaviors in the United States. Given its potential benefits, understanding how engagement is changing is vital. We used the American Time Use Survey (ATUS), a continuous cross‐sectional survey (2003−2023) measuring activities during the last 24 h.

pmc-13167626.title: Functional Data Strengthen Clinical Validation of PhenoScore Phenotype‐Guided AI for ANKRD11 Missense Variants
pmc-13167626.creator: Evi Andriessen, Elke de Boer, Gholson J Lyon, Bert B A de Vries, Charlotte W Ockeloen, Alexander J M Dingemans
pmc-13167626.description: KBG syndrome (KBGS, OMIM #148050) is a rare genetic disorder caused by heterozygous truncating or missense variants in the ANKRD11 gene or a deletion of 16q24.3 involving ANKRD11. While truncating variants clearly disrupt protein function, the interpretation of missense variants is more challenging, as many remain variants of uncertain significance (VUS).

pmc-13186986.title: Temperature-mediated plasticity of floral and fitness traits in Arabidopsis thaliana
pmc-13186986.creator: Jan Hoffmann, Gregory M Andreou-Huotari, Zoran Nikoloski, Roosa A E Laitinen, Anonymous, Anonymous, Daphne Ezer, Olivier Hamant, James Ronald, Pieter Arnold, Daphne Ezer, Olivier Hamant
pmc-13186986.description: Keywords: A. thaliana, fitness, phenotypic plasticity, selfing, temperature Introduction Floral traits, such as flowering time and flower size, are determinants of reproductive success and consequently fitness. In outcrossing species, variation in floral traits typically co-evolves with pollinators, with resources invested in producing larger or more attractive flowers (Goodwillie et al., 2010).

pmc-13214070.title: Conservative management of accidental tracheal perforation during surgery for descending necrotizing mediastinitis: a case report and literature review
pmc-13214070.creator: Hui Zhou, Tieniu Song
pmc-13214070.description: Survival of tracheal perforation secondary to descending necrotizing mediastinitis (DNM) is very rare, and it is difficult to manage accidental tracheal perforation during DNM surgery. We present a case of a 54-year-old man who had a large tracheal perforation due to DNM, which could not be confirmed preoperatively.

pmc-13378646.title: UK Infected Blood Inquiry–An Historical Appraisal
pmc-13378646.creator: Christopher A Ludlam
pmc-13378646.description: IntroductionThis appraisal considers the 2018 UK Infected Blood Inquiry and its Report (2024) in the context of the history of haemophilia treatment developments over the past fifty‐five years, and the tragic impacts of the AIDS pandemic.AimThe paper appraises the conduct and findings of the IBI and its Report in relation to HIV and AIDS.

pmc-13534507.title: Association of eosinophil levels with 30-day overall mortality in hospitalized patients with aspiration pneumonia
pmc-13534507.creator: Xia Jing, Li Li, Junyan Zhang, Haihong Zhao, Jing Li, Jixiu Fan, Jin Huo, Yueqin Li, Junkang Zhao

pmc-13558633.title: Machine learning prediction of customer satisfaction in fitness centres
pmc-13558633.creator: Manuel Alonso Dos Santos, Jerónimo García Fernández, Carlos Pérez Campos, Jonathan Cuevas Lizama

pmc-13563194.title: Clinical case of polymicrobial and multidrug-resistant posttraumatic chronic hip infection treatment
pmc-13563194.creator: Urban Vadnjal, Samo Roškar, René Mihalič, Mitja Rak, Rihard Trebše
pmc-13563194.description: A 40-year-old man, after a left acetabular fracture, had eight surgeries, suffered from chronic multidrug-resistant infection with fistula, and underwent multi-stage hip revision surgery with spacer exchange and reconstruction, combined with systemic and intra-articular antibiotic therapy. He remained infection-free at 3.5-year follow-up.
